name: signal_stft
expr: s = stft(x, 'Window', w, 'OverlapLength', 32, 'FFTLength', 64, 'FrequencyRange', 'twosided'); s_rows = size(s, 1); s_cols = size(s, 2); s11_re = real(s(1,1)); s11_im = imag(s(1,1)); s33_1_re = real(s(33,1)); s16_7_re = real(s(16,7)); sc = stft(x, 'Window', w, 'OverlapLength', 32, 'FFTLength', 64, 'FrequencyRange', 'centered'); sc11_re = real(sc(1,1)); sc33_1_re = real(sc(33,1)); so = stft(x, 'Window', w, 'OverlapLength', 32, 'FFTLength', 64, 'FrequencyRange', 'onesided'); so_rows = size(so, 1); xr = real(istft(s, 'Window', w, 'OverlapLength', 32, 'FFTLength', 64, 'FrequencyRange', 'twosided')); xr_inner_err = max(abs(x(64:end-64) - xr(64:end-64)')); [s2, f2, t2] = stft(x, fs, 'Window', w, 'OverlapLength', 32, 'FFTLength', 64, 'FrequencyRange', 'twosided'); ffs_len = length(f2); ffs_1 = f2(1); ffs_2 = f2(2); ffs_end = f2(end); tfs_len = length(t2); tfs_1 = t2(1); tfs_end = t2(end); [s2, f2, t2] = stft(x, fs, 'Window', w, 'OverlapLength', 32, 'FFTLength', 64, 'FrequencyRange', 'centered'); fcfs_1 = f2(1); fcfs_end = f2(end); [s2, f2, t2] = stft(x, fs, 'Window', w, 'OverlapLength', 32, 'FFTLength', 64, 'FrequencyRange', 'onesided'); fofs_len = length(f2); fofs_end = f2(end); [s2, f2, t2] = stft(x); fd_1 = f2(1); td_1 = t2(1); [xr2, tr] = istft(s, fs, 'Window', w, 'OverlapLength', 32, 'FFTLength', 64, 'FrequencyRange', 'twosided'); trt_1 = tr(1); trt_end = tr(end); trt_len = length(tr);
comment: MATLAB Signal Toolbox stft / istft. Cycle 86: [s, f, t] = stft(x, fs[, NV...]) multi-output added. fs positional (2nd arg, before NV-pairs); f in Hz (k*fs/NFFT) when fs given else radians/sample (k*2*pi/NFFT). t = (M/2 + k*hop) / fs_t at frame centres (fs_t = fs if given else 1 samples). istft 2nd output is column time vector t = (0:Nout-1)/fs. All three ranges (twosided / centered / onesided) bit-equal MATLAB R2025b. Octave 11.1.0 ships stft/istft in the signal package, not core.
